tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mai tri pra ni dha na rā dza/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// kun dga' bo ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ thal mo sbyar nas tshig 'di skad ces smon lam btab bo// sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo// drang srong lha mig ldan pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang yang*// nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ngan 'gro las ni bzlog bgyid cing*// mtho ris lam ni rab ston la// rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa// byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo// sems kyi dbang du gyur pas na// bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// bdag gis de dag bshags par bgyi// bdag las rnam pa gsum gang gis// bsod nams tshogs ni bskyed pa ni// bdag gi kun mkhyen sa bon te// bdag gi byang chub mi zad shog /phyogs bcu dag gi zhing khams su// sangs rgyas mchod pa gang byung ba// sangs rgyas mkhyen pas yi rang ba// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi// bsod nams kun la yi rang ngo*// sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag ni ye shes mchog thob shog /phyogs bcu dag gi phyogs rnams su// sa bcu dag la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mchog /'tshang rgya bgyid par bskul ma 'debs// byang chub dam par sangs rgyas shing*// sde dang bcas pa'i bdud btul nas// srog chags kun la sman slad du// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cig /chos rnga chen po'i sgra yis ni// sdug bsngal sems can mthar bgyid shog /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su// chos ston mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig

/'dod pa'i 'dam du bying gyur cing*// sred pa'i srad bus dam bcings pa// 'ching ba kun gyis bcings bdag la// rkang gnyis mchog rnams gzigs su gsu gsol// sems kyi dri mar gyur pa la// sangs rgyas rnams ni smod mi mi mdzad// sems can rnams la byams thugs ldan// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs dang*// gang dag 'das dang ma byon pa// de dag rjes su bdag slob cing*// byang chub spyod pa spyad gyur cig /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis nas// 'gro drug sems can thar bgyid shog /mngon shes drug po mngon bgyis nas// bla med byang chub reg gyur cig /ma skyes pa dang mi 'byung dang*// rang bzhin ma mchis gnas ma ma mchis// rnam rig ma mchis dngos ma mchis// stong pa'i chos ni rtogs par shog /sangs rgyas drang srong chen po ltar// sems can ma mchis srog ma mchis// gang zag ma mchis gso ma mchis// bdag ma mchis pa'i chos rtogs shog /bdag 'dzin bdag gir 'dzin pa yi// dngos po kun la mi gnas par// sems can kun la phan slad du// ser sna ma mchis sbyin gtong shog /dngos por dngos po ma mchis pas// bdag gi longs spyod lhun grub shog /dngos po thams cad rnam 'jig pa'i// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /khrims gyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*// tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan// rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis// tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sa 'am yang na chu 'am me// rlung gi khams ltar mi gnas shang*/ bzod pa'am khro ba ma mchis par// bzod pa'i pha rol phyan rdzogs shog /brtson 'grus brtsams pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// brtan spro le lo ma mchis shang*// stobs dang ldan pa'i lus sems kyis// brtson 'grus pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang*// dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin dang*// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// bsam gtan pha rol phyin rdzogs shog

/rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang*// dus gsum mnyam pa nyid dang ni/ rig gsum mngon gsum bgyis pa yis// shes rab pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa dang*// 'od dang gzi brjid 'bar ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyis// bdag gzhan bsam pa rdzogs gyur cig /de ltar spyod pa spyod byed cing*// byams pa grags dang ldan pa yis// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis na// sa bcu po la rab tu gnas// kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa gang la gnas nas thabs mkhas pas theg pa bde ba dang*/ 'jug pa bde ba dang*/ lam bde bas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas pa ni 'di yin no/// /bkra shis/// /
